reading_rule: Original selected scientific record. Source-state tokens remain dated history; later original qualification is separate.

timeline.event: Turing's checking-a-routine conference paper is documented by the archival record; its method and later influence are not newly examined here.
Floyd and Hoare formulate conditional reasoning about programs; termination, machine axioms and statement interpretation remain distinct questions.
Scott and Strachey's PRG6 develops mathematical program semantics; later reproduction dates are not a second invention.
Dijkstra's guarded commands and weakest-precondition treatment make nondeterminism and termination obligations explicit.
Abstract interpretation and temporal program reasoning address different problems: sound semantic approximation and time-dependent concurrent behavior.
CSP, VDM and CCS belong to different communicating-process and specification traditions in the native account; a single chain of descent is not established.
Clarke/Emerson's synchronization-skeleton work and Queille/Sifakis's CESAR work provide distinct early model-checking lines.
Social-process criticism, program/execution criticism and Hall's response challenge both perfection claims and categorical impracticality.
Safety/liveness definitions, concurrent history criteria and temporal/action models diversify the meanings of correctness.
Jackson and Wing articulate several dimensions of lightweight formalization, preserving deliberate partiality.
Vacuity, counterexample-guided refinement and local heap reasoning address inadequacy of successful checks, spurious warnings and aliasing.
Proof-carrying evidence, per-run translation validation, realistic compiler verification and kernel verification move assurance across explicit interfaces.
KLEE's path exploration and industrial surveys show practical uses with different scopes and evidence designs.
Refinement types for lazy Haskell expose an evaluation-order assumption and introduce a guarded repair.
Verified-distributed-system bugs, SMT-solver defect campaigns and RustBelt's relaxed-memory extension locate defects at specific boundaries.
Coq user experience, Isabelle compatibility and Dafny/Dezyne studies examine distinct maintenance and practitioner questions; publication year is not measurement date.
Unit proofs, repository theorem benchmarks, autoformalization and proof-certificate work advance distinct tasks with different evaluation populations.
The native 50-property/113-source replacement freeze is the historical scientific subject retained unchanged.
CompCert 3.18, SMT-LIB 2.7 revision of 2026-09-09 and later S102/S111 preprints supply subsequent versions, not independent replications.
This author's selected inquiry and constructed cases qualify the native study; independent scientific acceptance remains unperformed.

criticism.challenge: A true formal statement may miss the intended requirement or world.
criticism.response_trace: Separate theorem validity, statement relevance and external correspondence; use deliberate positive and negative examples.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A valid narrow lemma or hypothetical model does not require a complete stakeholder process.
criticism.ceiling: Current access to Fetzer’s full argument is limited; local cases establish the stated logical separations.

criticism.challenge: Specifications, annotations and proofs can cost more than their decision value.
criticism.response_trace: Use selective models, tractable fragments and explicit cost comparisons at the decision’s actual scope.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A cheap complete check or justified continuation with the existing control can be adequate.
criticism.ceiling: There is no controlled universal return estimate; recruitment and timing denominators remain source specific.

criticism.challenge: State explosion and undecidability block universal automatic completion.
criticism.response_trace: Retain finite exact domains as genuinely decidable cases and keep UNKNOWN inconclusive.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A small complete state space can be exhaustively checked without an unbounded theorem prover.
criticism.ceiling: No named reduction establishes a universal complexity improvement.

criticism.challenge: Abstract models can omit faults or produce spurious warnings.
criticism.response_trace: Make the transfer depend on the property class and approximation direction; determine whether witnesses are concrete or spurious.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A useful under-approximate witness or intentionally coarse model can be sufficient for its stated question.
criticism.ceiling: The original abstract-interpretation theorems were not fully re-read; local mathematical examples have only their specified scope.

criticism.challenge: Modular proofs may have incompatible or circular assumptions.
criticism.response_trace: Use sound composition rules, compatible interfaces, frames and explicit remaining premises; do not ban every circular proof structure.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: Useful partial component contributions and guarded circular rules are legitimate.
criticism.ceiling: The finite examples do not reproduce every published assume-guarantee theorem.

criticism.challenge: Tools, translations and proof rules can contain defects.
criticism.response_trace: Separate checking, semantic validation and testing by the boundary each addresses; disclose residual tool trust.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A defect report does not invalidate all earlier results, and a narrow valid certificate retains value.
criticism.ceiling: No current external tool binary was validated; code size is not a measured defect probability.

criticism.challenge: Proof maintenance can be brittle and encourage goal weakening.
criticism.response_trace: Separate mathematical truth, script compatibility, statement meaning and present application support.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: No change, affected-scope replay and historical retention remain admissible.
criticism.ceiling: Compatibility counts are not logical-unsoundness counts; versions of one paper are not replications.

criticism.challenge: Safety, type safety or a model proof can be oversold as all correctness.
criticism.response_trace: Name the actual property, semantics and transfer relation before extending a result to progress, function or security.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: Richer types or total-correctness reasoning can legitimately establish a stronger property.
criticism.ceiling: There is no blanket hierarchy that makes one method family stronger for every question.

criticism.challenge: Monitoring may miss events or respond too late.
criticism.response_trace: Separate observed-trace verdicts, detection, enforcement and recovery; quantify timing when the claim needs it.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: Passive detection and positive finite co-safety verdicts remain valid contributions.
criticism.ceiling: No production-monitor or operational-availability benchmark was performed.

criticism.challenge: Industrial successes and studies may be selected or self-reported.
criticism.response_trace: Use case feasibility and practitioner experience at their actual scope, with study, project and version dependence recorded.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: Selected positive evidence can be useful; lack of random sampling does not make it false.
criticism.ceiling: General causal effects, adoption prevalence and counterfactual cost remain unresolved.

criticism.challenge: Certification or formal-looking records can substitute for reasoning.
criticism.response_trace: Distinguish normative permission or obligation from formal truth and observed operational outcomes.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: Useful records and unchanged accepted reuse can reduce work without being ceremonial proxies.
criticism.ceiling: The paid DO-333 body was not read, and no clause-level compliance assessment is made.

criticism.challenge: AI evaluation can validate syntax or a shared mistranslation.
criticism.response_trace: Separate fixed-goal proof search, translation, reference fidelity, model/context/version and comparable baseline cost.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A checked AI-produced proof of the intended statement can be valid; whole regeneration can be an adequate baseline.
criticism.ceiling: No model call, contamination audit or benchmark replication occurred.

criticism.challenge: Changes in memory/compilation semantics invalidate an application inference.
criticism.response_trace: Adapt the relation or logic to the receiving semantics while retaining the old model theorem at its stated scope.
criticism.strongest_conditional_alternative: A deliberate sequentially consistent model is not false because a relaxed implementation behaves differently.
criticism.ceiling: No complete ISA, compiler-binary or physical side-channel verification was performed.

composition.name: Inductive evidence contributes to safety

composition.reverse_direction_assessment: Safety alone does not establish that P itself is inductive; C03 refutes that reverse inference.
composition.nontrigger_and_cheap_path: A direct reachability argument or finite enumeration may already establish P.

tensions.analysis: Smaller proofs need valid interfaces, frames and environment reasoning.
tensions.decision: A whole small model may be cheaper than an elaborate decomposition.

tensions.tension: Small trusted base and complete semantic chain
tensions.analysis: Certificate checkers can reduce search-tooltrust while leaving encoding/parsing/runtime assumptions.
tensions.decision: Identify which boundary is reduced; do not count tools as independent guarantees.

tensions.tension: Stable proof statements and changing needs
tensions.analysis: Preserving a theorem can conflict with a legitimate requirement change; repairing scripts can hide weakening.
tensions.decision: Review meaning and impacted uses rather than preserving green status at all costs.

tensions.analysis: Instrumentation/control can introduce overhead and false blocking; passive evidence can still be useful.
tensions.decision: State role and actionauthority before assigning fail-closed duties.

tensions.analysis: A reusable verifiedcomponent may lower cost, but a newplatform/use can violate assumptions.
tensions.decision: No-change is justified only for compatibleuses; no universal fullreproof.

tensions.tension: Powerful AI search and statement fidelity
tensions.analysis: Checked proofs may be reliable while translation remains mistaken; additional repair can increase cost without benefit.
tensions.decision: Use matched baselines and independent semantic discriminators.

dependence.accounting_rule: Same seL4 project and proof stack; two documentation pages do not create independent industrial replications.
Same CompCert lineage with different paper/manual roles and versions; a current manual is not a second empirical study.
Related RustBelt projects and shared proof foundations; later relaxed-memory extension is new scope, not a duplicate SC proof.
Shared cvc5/Alethe/CPC/Lean/Isabelle ecosystem and components; claim-specific theory/data overlap must be considered before pooling.
v1 and v3 are dependent versions of one research project; traffic/wildlife datasets and cross-model ablations are not interchangeable trials.
Versions 1 and 2 share a benchmark family; the 500-goal main set and 100-goal comparison subset are different denominators, not independent replications.

The 73 unit proofs and 89 reintroduced defects span four operating systems. Tasks and defects share projects; the last 21 proofs supply a post-learning developer-time measure, distinct from execution time.
The 2022 Coq cohort recurs in blog, conference and 2025 journal accounts. Its 466 submitted responses are not 466 independent tool experiments.
Different surveys/interviews/literature collections; some reuse famous projects and author reports. Exact overlap is not fully identified, so no pooled effect/prevalence estimate.
Originals, reprints, transcriptions and short/extended versions remain dependent work families, with exact access version retained.
Guidance/standards/case studies share a normative domain but answer different questions; recognition is not empirical efficacy.
Reports, unique confirmed bugs, fixed bugs and soundness bugs are nested or related campaign populations; they are neither all solver queries nor distinct independent studies.
Prover languages, proof goals, directed translations and benchmark representations are different units. Shared libraries and training exposure remain incompletely known.
